part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Food and cooking
questions: What kinds of food do you like to eat?
What kind of new food would you like to try? [Why?]
What was the last meal you cooked?
Do you prefer home-cooked food or food from restaurants? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe an interest or hobby that you enjoy.
points: how you became interested in it
how long you have been doing it
part2.closing: and explain what benefits you get from this interest or hobby.

topics.title: The social benefits of hobbies
questions: Do you think having a hobby is good for people's social life? In what way?
Are there any negative effects of a person spending too much time on their hobby? What are they?
Why do you think people need to have an interest or hobby?

topics.title: Leisure time
questions: In your country, how much time do people spend on work and how much time on leisure? Is this a good balance, do you think?
Would you say the amount of free time has changed much in the last fifty years?
Do you think people will have more or less free time in the future? Why?
